Date Approved: 
 03 Feb 2009
تاريخ المراد مراجعتها: Feb 2014
مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed annually bases as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block.

In ventilation and air condition system chilled water system 
 carries out the function to release in to the cooling water heat absorbed by 
 air conditioning units in to air conditioned rooms and building heat removal 
 function is performed all the year around

ينقسم نظام الماء المبرد إلى قسمين:- قسم 
 يقوم المرء بإنتاج وتوزيع الماء المبرد على وحدات تكييف الهواء 
 التدفقات :
Ventilated areas
Control room air conditioner
مكيف هواء غرفة التتابع

Main supply disconnected switch 
 in open position

Maintenance is carried out with 
 cooperation with electrical department

sections.text:
العمل ليكون 
نفذت

Check that the characteristics of the pump (flow and head) suit the capacity 
 of the units
Check provide piping to allow condensers cleaning

Check the level of the oil into the compressors through the relevant sight 
 glass (at least on the half of the sight glass)

Check eventual refrigerant gas leaking by means of suitable equipment and the 
 refrigerant flow must be continuous liquid line and without bubbles after the 
 solenoid valve
Check that the on-off valve of the manometers are opened
Refrigerant adding on low pressure side if need it
Empty the low pressure circuit
Connect the oil pump fitted on the compressor sump after a dearator filter

Discharge the connection pipe and when the oil is on the sump connection 
 pump the oil into the sump as long as oil level reaches the half position of 
 the sight glass
Take out the pipe and close the connection

items: Connect the oil pump fitted on the compressor sump after a dearator filter

Discharge the connection pipe and when the oil is on the sump connection 
 pump the oil into the sump as long as oil level reaches the half position of 
 the sight glass
Take out the pipe and close the connection

sections.text: Take out the pipe and close the connection
Clean slide and butterfly dampers
Clean air filter by jet of air or water for H.A unit
Check the condition and tension of fan and motor driving belts
Make sure that the fan blades have not suffered any damage
